items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I know he wrote me while I was in the hospital and said that Sonny was doing a good job

ctx.x: I know he wrote me while I was in the hospital and said that Sonny was doing a good job, and he think he'd make a good drummer with the band, good flashy drummer, and that he was going to keep him with the band while I was still in the hospital.
